statements.text: According to the expired G.O.Rt.No.1184, any continuation of outsourcing services beyond 31-03-2026 requires fresh orders of the Government.
statements.quote: Any continuation beyond 31-03-2026 shall require fresh orders of the Government.

statements.text: An unestablished draft note suggests that reference to the Finance Department may not be necessary for the continuation since it is on the same terms.
statements.quote: Since the continuation is on the same terms, reference to the Finance Department may not be necessary.

statements.text: An unestablished order states that no existing engagement shall be extended or continued without the prior concurrence of the Finance Department and the approval of the Government.
statements.quote: Government hereby order that no services shall be contracted or outsourced, and no existing engagement shall be extended or continued, without the prior concurrence of the Finance Department and the approval of the Government.

statements.text: An expired circular memo states that no services shall be contracted, outsourced, or continued without the prior concurrence of the Finance Department.
statements.quote: Government have ordered that no services shall be contracted or outsourced, or continued, without the prior concurrence of the Finance Department.
